subject: Discovery follow-up: lock demo window & introduce security/procurement
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Stone <ariel.stone@talentflow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: lock demo window & introduce security/procurement

Hi Ariel —

Great conversation today, and thanks for walking through TalentFlow’s 2Q priorities. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Goal: run a 45–60 minute technical deep dive/demo targeted at your platform & security teams (showing inference performance and privacy controls).
2) Proposed windows (PT):
   - Thu Sep 16, 10:00–10:45
   - Fri Sep 17, 14:30–15:15
   - Tue Sep 21, 09:30–10:15

Please tell us which slot works best or share a few alternatives.

3) Who to loop: you mentioned Nikhil from security and procurement@talentflow for contract/terms. I’m cc’ing Marissa (AE) and Sean (Customer Success) to assist scheduling and procurement next steps.

4) Pre-work: attaching a short agenda and a one-sheet for SOC2 evidence we typically share. If Nikhil can send any must-have checklist items in advance, Rishi (SE) will prepare specific slides/data.

Attachments: 20260908-MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

If that plan looks good I’ll go ahead and send a calendar invite once you pick a slot.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Rep, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference for engineering teams

Cc: Nikhil Rao <n.raosec@talentflow.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@talentflow.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: lock demo window & introduce security/procurement

Thanks, Irene —

Appreciate the clear recap. All three windows look plausible; primary preference is Tue Sep 21, 09:30 PT. Nikhil (security) and procurement are cc’d here — Nikhil, quick note on priorities: data residency controls, KV cache lifecycle, and an outline of evidence we can expect for SOC2/contracting. Procurement, please confirm if the following PO flow is required: initial MSA review -> security attachment -> commercial terms -> PO.

I’ll wait for Marissa/Sean to send the invite.

Best,
Ariel
Head of Platform Engineering | TalentFlow
ariel.stone@talentflow.com | (650) 222-1188
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: lock demo window & introduce security/procurement

Perfect — thanks Ariel. Locking Tue Sep 21, 09:30–10:15 PT.

Rishi, can you prepare a short appendix on: quantization/latency tradeoffs (3 slides), KV cache TTL behavior, and a map of where logs/audit trails live for Private deployments? Nikhil — if you can drop 2–3 specific evidence items (e.g., retention window, redaction controls) into the thread, we’ll attach them to the SOC2 packet. Procurement — I’ll share our standard MSA + option sheet; please flag any gating terms.

Irene will own the demo agenda and keep it focused to 45 minutes + 15 min Q&A. Calendar invite and drive folder link to follow.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-ask.csv (CSV)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — I’ll prepare the appendix and upload slides to the Drive folder by EOD tomorrow. Quick notes:
- Confirmed demo scope: inference latency at 1K tokens, prefix caching demo, and a short run of the private-deploy audit trail.
- Will include a short table mapping common evidence requests to where they appear in logs (example rows added to SOC2-evidence-ask.csv).

I’ve attached a stub calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) for Tue Sep 21, 09:30 PT — Marissa, feel free to update the invite with final agenda.

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (ICS)

See you Tuesday —
